full.description: This is a micrograph of a cervical tissue biopsy stained with hematoxylin and eosin. The image displays stratified squamous epithelium overlying a connective tissue stroma. The epithelial cells show nuclear atypia, variation in size and shape, and loss of normal maturation, which are features characteristic of mild dysplasia of the cervix.

random.description: This is a micrograph showing a section of stratified squamous epithelium, likely from the skin or mucosa. The H and E stained tissue section reveals multiple layers of epithelial cells overlying connective tissue. The basal layer contains darkly stained nuclei, while the upper layers show flattened cells toward the surface. The overall appearance is consistent with normal or reactive stratified squamous epithelial tissue.
